title: fraction-bar widget params
description: Per-question configuration for the fraction-bar explanatory widget.

numerator.description: Top of the fraction. Clamped to [0, denominator]. Default 1.

denominator.description: Bottom of the fraction. Must be a positive integer, capped at 40 so segments stay visible. Default 4.

mode.description: `shaded` (default) hides the numerals so the question can ask the student to name the fraction. `labelled` shows `n/d` below the bar for hints / worked solutions.

title.description: Optional title shown above the bar (e.g. 'Bar A').
